steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Tessai-san has been inside for quite a while. I'm starting to get worried...

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Don't worry about him. The Old Man at his forge is like you singing on stage, Hoshiguma punching someone, or me at a pachinko machine.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Are you really good at pachinko?

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Ah—hehe...
Trying to change the subject, Kichisei takes a cookie from the plate in front of her and puts it in her mouth.

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Uh oh, I've almost eaten all the cookies.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Why are all the cookies here Ninomiya's classic cystymilk flavor? Is it Tessai-san's favorite?

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Tetsuya used to like it.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: If Tetsuya realized what kind of man Kinbee was...

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: He would have realized it a long time ago if he could.

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: To be fair, Tetsuya following Kinbee around is really just the effect. The root cause goes back to Old Man Tessai—
If only Tessai had half your wisdom, Kichisei-san.

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Kinbee?!

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Go inside, Momoka! I'll hold him off!

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Let's not rush to a fight, kiddo.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: My, my. How honored I am, to be welcomed by the oyabun himself.

steps.name: Tessai
steps.text: Where is Hoshiguma?

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: She is enjoying the hospitality of my people, and is unable to help you.

steps.name: Kichisei
steps.text: Despicable scum!

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Blame yourself. I was trying to bait her with Moriuchi, but she bit the hook before I even had time to set the bait.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: But I don't like to kill unless I have to. These are more civilized times.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: I'm here to extend a sincere invitation to Chairman Tessai to attend my accession ceremony.

steps.name: Momoka
steps.text: Your what?

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: You heard me.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: If Chairman Tessai will not hand over Kajimachi whatsoever, then I must take the small liberty of taking over the leadership of the Kinsekikai. After all, the position is already little more than a figurehead.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: If you are too embarrassed to attend, you can simply hand over Hannya, and the ceremony can take place without you.

steps.name: Tessai
steps.text: Hannya is not the symbol of succession, never was!

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: It is if everyone believes it is.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: You favored Hoshiguma too much. You never even realized it, did you?

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Or did you choose to give Hannya to Hoshiguma before she went to Lungmen for the sole purpose of snubbing me? What did she have that I didn't, that you would detest me so?

steps.name: Tessai
steps.text: You think too highly of yourself.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Yes! That's what I wanted to hear!

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: It's not that I think too highly of myself, Old Man. You look down on everyone except for your beloved Hoshiguma!
Standing alone at the door, Mifune laughs.
Momoka and Kichisei slowly move back behind Tessai.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Perhaps your son would not have turned against you if I told you this sooner.

steps.name: Tessai
steps.text: Why bring up Tetsuya? Did you think I opposed you in order to pass leadership onto that kid? He's not made for it.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: I know. He's another one you look down on.

steps.name: Tessai
steps.text: Enough talk. I may not be able to beat you, but it's not so hard to stall you until Hoshiguma gets back. This is my house, after all.

steps.name: Tessai
steps.text: Also, it'll be a good chance to try out the reforged Hannya.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Tameshigiri? Wonderful.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: I have something to show you before that, though.
Mifune reaches into his clothes.
Tessai keeps a careful eye on his movements, but all Mifune does is take out a few photos, casually tossing them to the floor.
Tessai catches a glimpse of one of the photos, which falls face-up in front of him—

steps.name: Tessai
steps.text: Tetsuya?!

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Tetsuya.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Such a good boy. He did everything I asked of him to the limits of his ability, whether he could ultimately handle it or not.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: For example, he really did find the Northern Court spy... himself.

steps.name: Tessai
steps.text: Why—you?!

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: I was surprised when I first saw the photos, but then it started to make sense.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Tetsuya's mother may have missed her family in the north, but she steadfastly refused any approach to become a spy.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Yet the mark of Hoashi was on all the weapons that we, the Kinsekikai, procured in secret.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: My fault, I suppose. The Kinsekikai's TV station wasn't as powerful as it is now, and those who wanted a piece of the Kinsekikai would have set upon the news like hungry beasts.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Eventually, I helped you find a place for the weapons, but you had to take care of the aftermath. You were forced to place the blame on Tetsuya's mother, as you once placed it on Hoshiguma.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: To you, the Kinsekikai is the King on the shogi board.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: You will preserve it at all costs, never hesitating to cut other pieces loose, be it a Queen like Hoshiguma, or Promoted Rooks like me that you look down on.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: I'm curious myself... what does Tetsuya mean to you?

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Is he a Rook? A Bishop? Or is he so incompetent that you see him as a Pawn you wouldn't mind losing?

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: If that was really so, we would have to have a fight here and now. But he isn't, is he?

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: He is incompetent, but he's not a shogi piece. He's your precious son, not to be placed on the board—

steps.name: Tessai
steps.text: Shut up!
Clearly on edge, the old man seems ready to charge at Mifune with shield raised at any moment.
But Mifune can see Hannya trembling in his hands.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: His mother's name will never be cleared. If the same fate befalls your only remaining child...

steps.name: Tessai
steps.text: I said, SHUT UP!

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: You're hesitating. You're contemplating whether there's a chance the reforged Hannya will allow you to neutralize me in one blow, and bargain my life for Tetsuya's.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Chance. What an obnoxious word.

steps.name: Tessai
steps.text: Are you scared?

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: Unfortunately for you, there is more than one person who carries out my will.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: I'm not claiming strength in numbers, but the moment you swing Hannya at me, a button will be pressed, and these photos will show up on Kinseki Channel.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: And you'll be free, once and for all, when Tetsuya realizes that he was right, and his father never cared about him, just as his father never cared about his mother.

steps.name: Mifune
steps.text: What do you say, Old Man?

steps.name: Voice on TV
steps.text: What do you say, Old Man?

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: What...?

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: No, it's not true! It can't be!

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: Tell me this isn't real!
Tetsuya frantically shakes the shoulders of the ninja who brought him here, but he cannot even tell if the ninja is looking at him.

steps.name: Mifune's Voice
steps.text: After so many years, you have finally delivered Hannya into the hands of its true master.

steps.name: Mifune's Voice
steps.text: Unfortunately, I still have to complete certain task entrusted to me. Where is the deed to Kajimachi? No rush, the one who gave me the task wanted it done cleanly. For now, you can simply follow me.

steps.name: Tessai's Voice
steps.text: Those two...

steps.name: Mifune's Voice
steps.text: The girls? I'm certainly willing to do you a favor, since you've been cooperative so far. Come quietly, and I'll spare their lives.

steps.name: Kichisei's Voice
steps.text: You can go to hell, Kinbee! I'll cut your tail off and make a belt out of it—

steps.name: Tessai's Voice
steps.text: Kichisei!
His father's angry voice comes through the TV's speakers somewhat distorted, giving the scene a sense of surrealness.

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: Papa... Papa!

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: Where are you taking him? Let him go! You want to get me, come for me! Why him? Why?!

steps.name: Hidden Ninja
steps.text: Mio-san. Where is the Ao-Oni?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Mifune-san's orders were to let her go when the time is right, and allow her to return to Kajimachi.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: What of the boy? When do we let him go? Or are there other plans?

steps.name: Hidden Ninja
steps.text: I don't know. The orders from upstairs were to keep him in the room, and don't let him break anything in it. I wasn't told anything else.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: I see.

steps.name: Hidden Ninja
steps.text: Mio-san... see, I'm not sure how long I'll have to watch him, and I was up all night last night... I'm very tired, to tell the truth...

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: You can go.

steps.name: Hidden Ninja
steps.text: Arigatou!

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: What's on the TV?

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: Let me go.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: I asked a question.

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: Let me go!

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Mifune-san's orders are that you are not to leave this room.

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: My father's gone with your people! He's yielded! What else do you want?!

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: I'm simply following orders.
The young Oni draws his bokutou, but the ethereal hand emerging from behind the Liberi easily brings him to the ground.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Don't waste your energy.

steps.name: Mifune's Voice
steps.text: Won't you say something, Chairman Tessai?

steps.name: Mifune's Voice
steps.text: Have you decided to stay silent for now? Suit yourself, as long as you speak when I tell you to.
The camera follows Tessai.
Tetsuya sees his father leave the manor and enter a car stopped in front of its gate.
After a short while, the door of the car opens. Through an unremarkable door is a splendorous meeting hall.

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: What's this place?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Auction hall.

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: Auctioning what? Kajimachi? You don't mean my father's...?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Auctioneer's Voice
steps.text: The next item for auction is not listed in the catalog. It was added at the last minute.

steps.name: Auctioneer's Voice
steps.text: I present... the very first ever TV set manufactured by the Kinseki Group!

steps.name: Auctioneer's Voice
steps.text: Starting at... s-seven million!

steps.name: Auctioneer's Voice
steps.text: A TV set that looks so unremarkable, yet starting at the remarkable price of two thousand ryou... there must be something extraordinary about it!

steps.name: Mifune's Voice
steps.text: Seven million, five hundred thousand.

steps.name: Auctioneer's Voice
steps.text: Kouhei Mifune san? Are you serious?

steps.name: Mifune's Voice
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Mifune's Voice
steps.text: I doubt I'm the only one who recognizes its value.

steps.name: Auctioneer's Voice
steps.text: A-Are you sure?

steps.name: Auctioneer's Voice
steps.text: Regardless... we have a bid for seven million, five hundred thousand from Kouhei Mifune-san!

steps.name: Auctioneer's Voice
steps.text: Seven million five hundred thousand going once... seven million five hundred thousand going twice...

steps.name: Tessai's Voice
steps.text: ...Ten million.
In the middle of the screen, the aging Oni slowly raises the paddle in his hand.
His old, feeble voice comes through the TV speakers.

steps.name: Auctioneer's Voice
steps.text: That's... Chairman Tessai of the Kinsekikai?!

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: What did Mifune say... fifteen million? He's still raising the bid? What is he trying to do, kill my father by putting him into debt?
The Liberi says nothing, but the young man sees a hint of pity in her eyes that goes a little further than what the number 'fifteen million' should elicit.

steps.name: Auctioneer's Voice
steps.text: Two hundred million?! You are bidding two hundred million, Tessai-san?!

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: Two...

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Two hundred million?!

steps.name: Auctioneer's Voice
steps.text: Two hundred million going once... two hundred million going twice... Last chance at two hundred million... sold.
Tetsuya watches as Tessai rises from his seat and walks past rows of well-dressed buyers, towards the TV set that should have belonged to him to begin with.

steps.name: Auctioneer's Voice
steps.text: Tessai-san, there is still paperwork to be done...
Tessai ignores the auctioneer and gently lifts the TV set, the way he did when he marketed it to potential buyers, one-at-a-time, many years ago.
Tetsuya raises his bokutou again.
He charges at Mio in desperation, but is once again thrown easily to the floor.
Again, and again...
The TV set continues to mercilessly send distorted sounds into the room.
The sound of camera shutters, of people giving a show of applauding, of footsteps, of the rustling of pen on paper, of car doors shutting, of car engines rumbling.
The now-unfamiliar sound of the door to his father's manor.
Tetsuya has lost count of how many times he has gotten back up after being thrown to the ground by Mio. He charges futilely again, when he hears the voices behind him.
One, like a ghost; the other, like a man-eating Akki.
Voices that hardly even seem human anymore.

steps.name: Mifune's Voice
steps.text: Now, give me the deed.

steps.name: Mifune's Voice
steps.text: Sign here, stamp your handprint, and all will be done.

steps.name: Mifune's Voice
steps.text: You still can't do it, can you?

steps.name: Mifune's Voice
steps.text: But you understand that none of it is over, until you've put your palm to the page.

steps.name: Tessai's Voice
steps.text: And what happens when I do?

steps.name: Mifune's Voice
steps.text: The deed to Kajimachi will become the collateral on a loan in the amount of two hundred million. The TV set is yours, once you give the payment to the auction house—

steps.name: Tessai's Voice
steps.text: It's Tetsuya that I'm talking about!

steps.name: Mifune's Voice
steps.text: Him? Same as always. Those photos of him will be sealed away forever.

steps.name: Mifune's Voice
steps.text: You'll never be able to pay back the debt. We can keep this secret together, and he'll be none the wiser.
The two people in the room with the TV both freeze.
Even the Liberi, who should have seen plenty of such things, takes an involuntary step backward.

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: You liar!

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: He's a liar! Mifune is a liar! Don't do it! No!

steps.name: Mifune's Voice
steps.text: I know. It's not easy, choosing between abandoning your son and a crushing debt.

steps.name: Tessai's Voice
steps.text: Money? I don't care about money...

steps.name: Tessai's Voice
steps.text: Money. Business. Titles. Land. None of that matters anymore.

steps.name: Tessai's Voice
steps.text: But only this... bowing my head to rotten scum like you...

steps.name: Mifune's Voice
steps.text: And yet bow you will.

steps.name: Mifune's Voice
steps.text: Bow you will, for the Tetsuya you failed to save from the rampaging Akki, and for the other Tetsuya you almost made a traitor out of.

steps.name: Tessai's Voice
steps.text: Promise me. You won't kill Tetsuya, or Hoshiguma, or those two girls.

steps.name: Mifune's Voice
steps.text: I won't.

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: He tricked me! He tricked me! Don't let him trick you!

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: You're the oyabun of the Kinsekikai! You're Tessai the Kingpin! You're my father! Papa! Papa!

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: This isn't supposed to happen! This isn't who you are!

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: You're the villain who can turn Mitsukue's yakuza upside-down with a wave of your hand! You're the steel-hearted murderer who killed my mother! This isn't who you are!

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: Papa—
As the old man places his hand on the inkpad, then leaves his red handprint on the paper, it seems like all life has been sucked out of him.

steps.name: Mifune's Voice
steps.text: Good. Very good.

steps.name: Mifune's Voice
steps.text: By the way, your son just saw everything that happened, from beginning to end. I'm sure he'll be grateful to you. No need to thank me.

steps.name: Tessai's Voice
steps.text: You—how dare you?!

steps.name: Mifune's Voice
steps.text: Your son thought he was the same as me. He thought you always looked down on him as you looked down on me, thinking of him as a worthless substitute.

steps.name: Mifune's Voice
steps.text: I hope he learned his lesson, and stops thinking of himself as the most pitiable man under Heaven.

steps.name: Mifune's Voice
steps.text: How lucky he is, to have someone willing to trample the last vestige of his own dignity for him.
A wave of the fan, and the hand-printed sheet is cut in half, but Mifune continues to sneer.
The image on the TV starts shaking. Something seems to have moved the camera.

steps.name: Mifune's Voice
steps.text: Here's the camera.

steps.name: Tessai's Voice
steps.text: You... you deceived me? You let Tetsuya know about all this... you never meant to spare him?

steps.name: Tessai's Voice
steps.text: Why? Why would you deceive Hoshiguma, deceive me, deceive Tetsuya?!

steps.name: Mifune's Voice
steps.text: 'Deceive' is such a strong word.

steps.name: Mifune's Voice
steps.text: Hoshiguma learned that her choice was only ever wishful thinking.

steps.name: Mifune's Voice
steps.text: Tetsuya learned that you did love him, after all.

steps.name: Mifune's Voice
steps.text: And you—you understand now, don't you?

steps.name: Mifune's Voice
steps.text: Mitsukue no longer needs you or the hypocrisy of the Kinsekikai. Everything you've done was to fool yourself—
A loud noise comes through the speakers as the camera is smashed. The screen goes dark, but the speakers continue to mercilessly communicate the sound.
The sound of Tessai's fan clashing with Mifune's sword.
The sound of labored footsteps.
The sound of blade impaling flesh.

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: ...Papa?
The sound of blood dripping.

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: Papa—
The sound of a body hitting the floor.

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: Papa!!!

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: Die on the battlefield... or... or die fighting cops, die to my vengeful blade! Don't die like this—

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: Don't—

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: Don't die for me like this—humiliated... trampled beneath another man's feet...

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: Y-You don't deserve to be my father. But I don't deserve to have you die for me like this!

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: Why would you do this for me? Why would you do this for a fool?!

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: Papa...

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Mifune-san...?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Yes, I took over from the ninja.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: His reaction...? I'm sure you can imagine.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: You... you have no further use for him?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: —Yes! What other orders do you have?

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Yes, I will go to the place where Momoka is being held.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: But was there not someone else? The woman by the name of Kichisei—

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: Mio, is it?

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: Mifune told you to kill me, didn't he?

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: He wants to wrap things up cleanly. He doesn't want any loose ends, does he?

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: Then do it. Kill me here and now.

steps.name: Tetsuya
steps.text: Otherwise, I'll kill you with my tooth and nail, whatever it takes to get out of here.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Go.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Go. Before I change my mind.

steps.name: Mio
steps.text: Never come back.
Has the sun set?
Tessai does not know.
He has lost track of time.
He remembers falling to Mifune's blade. He remembers Mifune grabbing his hand and leaving a bloody handprint on a new contract.
Then, the footsteps grow distant, and his vision grows grey and blurry.
He wants to be free of all this—
Uncle Tessai?!

The old man stands back up feebly as he hears the familiar voice, perhaps out of guilt, perhaps out of lingering sentiment, perhaps because he does not want Hoshiguma to see the true extent of his weakness.

steps.name: Tessai
steps.text: ...Hoshiguma?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Who did this? Kinbee?!

steps.name: Tessai
steps.text: Hoshiguma... I couldn't protect Kajimachi... or Hannya...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Where's Momoka? Kichisei?

steps.name: Tessai
steps.text: Kinbee was right about one thing... sitting in my chair... I started thinking of everything as shogi pieces...

steps.name: Tessai
steps.text: Moving them... trading them... sacrificing them...

steps.name: Tessai
steps.text: But I forgot... I'm no more than a shogi piece myself, in the eyes of others...

steps.name: Tessai
steps.text: Run... you're no match for Kinbee... leave this forsaken place... go back... go back to Lungmen...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: No, I won't!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Sit down, Uncle Tessai. I'll find a doctor—

steps.name: Tessai
steps.text: *cough* *cough* Don't... bother...

steps.name: Tessai
steps.text: Can't you see... I'm beyond help...?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Uncle Tessai—

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I'm here, Uncle Tessai. I'm not going anywhere.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Sit down. We'll sit together for a little bit... just like old times.
Hoshiguma helps the dying old man sit down.
She casts her gaze toward the tall walls in the distance. There are lights flashing outside, and the sound of tracks rolling over the ground.
She does not care what it means. Kajimachi is dead, and she cares not what will become of it later.
All she knows is that she must stay with the dying man.
The old man's breathing grows weaker and weaker, but he begins to feel the rumbling of tracks too.
He looks up in terror, but his eyes can no longer see. The ground trembles beneath him.

steps.name: Tessai
steps.text: Is that... a sound... I can't hear...?

steps.name: Tessai
steps.text: What is it, Hoshiguma... what is it...?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: It's—
Hoshiguma stops in mid-sentence, choking back tears.
After a while, she growls from the back of her throat—

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: It's the signal... to begin the fireworks show.

steps.name: Tessai
steps.text: The fireworks... have begun?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Yes. They're getting ready. You hear the commotion, don't you?

steps.name: Tessai
steps.text: Yes... Kajimachi hasn't been so lively... in a long time...
A smile appears on the old man's face.
An engineering vehicle rams through the manor's walls, causing the beams to shake violently.
Not too far away, the pachinko parlor's machines are crushed to pieces, sending tiny balls flying everywhere.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Do you hear... the fireworks...?

steps.name: Tessai
steps.text: Yes...
The sound of fireworks going off, taiko drums rumbling, the noise of the crowd.
He feels the trembling of the ground again, its joyful dance.
He hears the faint sound of car horns, from vehicles caught in the traffic jam outside.
He senses his own heartbeat growing slower by the second.

steps.name: Tessai
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Tessai
steps.text: No... I can't...
In his final moments, his heart races once more, and hot blood flows swift through his veins, as the dying man gazes at the sunset, thinking that it is the rising sun—
The wrinkled hands fall weakly.

steps.name: Tired Police
steps.text: Found the body that the witness reported... and the suspect, matching the description of Hoshiguma!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Was this part of Kinbee's plan too?

steps.name: Tired Police
steps.text: Shut up and come with us.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Calling the police, letting you see me with Uncle Tessai as he draws his last breath, so that I'll once again be suspected of murder...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Was this part of Kinbee's plan too?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Did his people call you?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: ...I see.
Hoshiguma takes a leap and sees a familiar foe before the policeman says anything.
Yakuza. Ninja.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You're in league with each other?
The policeman looks down at his own feet—as Hoshiguma swings her unsheathed sword, trying to cut a path through the faint but inevitable dusk.
